title: Freightliner CCST FUPS Bullbar #12
description: Freightliner CST Columbia hi-tensile aluminium FUPS bullbar. 88mm diameter hi-tensile 6mm wall pipe. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Fully gusseted contoured main channel to suit truck design. Mounted to chassis on a heavy high tensile aluminium backing plate, provision for front mudflaps. Contoured main channel. Indicator repeater lights mounted in outer box uprights plus LED strip lights on plate on top of the main channel. Provision for front mudflaps. Bull bar can me custom built to your specifications.
